title: Pure creation and fun reworked
description: This modpack is the reworked more stable and new version of my pure creation and fun modpack as always greatly optimized and pure fun
body:
**As said in the summary this is just a more stable and thus fun version of my pure creation and fun modpack** mainly because ive had some issues makng the other pack work **as neoforge is really unstable and this is my stable version of that modpack** and added some other extra mods for a greater experience and less lag this way you can make a enormous factory with less fps drops if you have a kinda decent pc so **this is the only version of my create modpacks that would be updated at the moment with the discontinuing of the non-reworked modpack** and as the name implies make your experience more fun i also removed all stuff like resource packs to make setting up easier
**Anyways this projects adds:** create mod and some addons suitable for all play styles and play stages such as create nuclear for a risky late game enchantment industry for better enchantments in the mid game or structures arise to get some starter stuff and get set up so you can go straight into creating or maybe a more optimized gamplay so theres less lag such as create:cobblestone storage drawers and all of he best preformance mods of course or you are more of an asthetic builder then we have stuff for you! with create:encased for more seemless integration on your builds and chipped for a ton of custom blocks and palletes or just as as an all-rounder pack this is for you! or are you an explorer? then you also have stuff create:jetpacks and stuff and additions for better movement options also sophisticated backpacks for storing all your stuff and tectonic for those beautiful landscapes!
> **Ram quote:** allocating 3gb of ram is the minimum for a convinient experience although 3.5-4gb is optimal and reccomended
